value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"A contact at a provincial commerce bureau (someone who has been reliable on prior subsidy mechanics) said a internal draft is circulating that would let the national consumer trade-in program for phones and other electronics lapse after December rather than extend it into 1H27.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"China consumer trade-in subsidy continuation","period":"1H27","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"The program subsidizes 15% of the retail price on handsets, with a per-unit cap, for models priced under 6,000 yuan.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"reported_fact","metric":"China trade-in subsidy rate on handsets","period":null,"value":15,"unit":"pct","direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"Our channel survey from September suggested roughly a third of mainland iPhone sell-through in the quarter touched the program in some way.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"share of mainland iPhone sell-through touching trade-in program","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"If the subsidy ended in January, the pull-forward into the holiday quarter could be followed by a soft Mar-quarter comp in Greater China.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"opinion","metric":"Greater China Mar-quarter comp","period":"Mar-quarter","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false}]}
